description: This file defines the interface and data structures for managing DRM/KMS display settings within a Linux environment. It declares a context structure, various setup and cleanup functions, property retrieval functions, and plane management functions.
external_methods: drmModeObjectProperties *drmModeObjectGetProperties(int fd, uint32_t object_id, uint32_t object_type)
published: uint32_t kms_get_properties(int fd, drmModeObjectProperties *props, const char *name)

methods.name: kms_setup
methods.description: Initializes and allocates a new KMS context based on a given DRM file descriptor.

methods.name: kms_cleanup_context
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a given KMS context.

methods.name: kms_setup_encoder
methods.description: Associates an encoder with the KMS context based on available encoders.

methods.name: kms_setup_connector
methods.description: Associates a connector with the KMS context based on available connectors.

methods.name: kms_setup_crtc
methods.description: Associates a CRTC (Cathode Ray Tube Controller) with the KMS context.

methods.name: kms_get_properties
methods.description: Retrieves specific property ID for a given object property name.

methods.name: kms_get_plane
methods.description: Retrieves primary and overlay plane IDs for the device.
